Engineering Colleges in Telangana 2026: Fees, Admissions, Placements, Rankings, Cutoff

Shawon Roy Chowdhury

Content Strategist at Collegedunia | Updated on - Jul 6, 2026

IIT Hyderabad, NIT Warangal, IIIT Hyderabad, BITS Hyderabad, and JNTU Hyderabad are Telangana's top engineering colleges according to the Collegedunia 2026 rankings. Collegedunia has given IIIT Hyderabad an overall score of 958 (out of 1000), IIT Hyderabad 953 (out of 1000), and NIT Warangal 929 (out of 1000). 

Key Summary

  • Fee Range:
    • Government: 42K at MANUU, Hyderabad, to 20 lakh at IIIT, Hyderabad.
    • Private: 3.22 lakh at BRECW Hyderabad to 28.85 lakh at Woxsen University.
  • Placements: Highest Package: 1.28 CPA (IIIT Hyderabad) | Median Packages: 4.20 LPA at BVRIT Hyderabad to 34.40 LPA at IIIT Hyderabad.
  • Best ROI: 260.55% ROI (IIT Hyderabad) (Avg Package: 19.15 LPA | Fee: 12.11 lakh). 
  • Cheapest Option: MANUU Hyderabad (42.8 K), SITE Hyderabad (68.8 K), and NETW Hyderabad (1.40 lakh). 
  • Main Entrance Exams:
    • TS EAMCET: Accepted by 108 colleges (JNTUH Hyderabad, UCE Hyderabad, and VNR VJIET Hyderabad). 
    • JEE Main: Accepted by 24 colleges (IIIT Hyderabad, Woxsen University, and GNITS Hyderabad). 
  • Best for CSE: IIT Hyderabad, IIIT Hyderabad, and JNTUH College of Engineering.
  • Best for ECE: IIIT Hyderabad, JNTUH College of Engineering, and VNT VJIET Hyderabad.
  • Top Government BTech Colleges in Kolkata: IIT Hyderabad (Avg – 20.81 LPA), IIIT Hyderabad (Avg – 33.96 LPA), JNTUH Hyderabad (Avg - 6 LPA).
  • Top Private BTech Colleges in Kolkata: BITS Hyderabad (Avg - 20.77 LPA), VNR VJIET Hyderabad (Avg - 7.35 LPA), Woxsen University (Avg - 9.90 LPA).

Ques. Is 70 a Good Score in TS EAMCET?

Ans. A score of 70 out of 160 is decent but not outstanding. Here's the ground reality:

  • Rank: Falls around 20,000–30,000
  • Government colleges: Difficult to secure, especially in the CSE branches
  • Private colleges: Mid-tier institutions are accessible for ECE, IT, or Mechanical
  • Reserved categories (SC/ST/BC/EWS): Admission options widen considerably.

College Name Overall Ratings Academics Faculty Most Loved Things Areas of Improvement

IIT Hyderabad 4.3 (229 Reviews) 4.2 4.3 Qualified Teachers, Internship Opportunities, Hostels, Placements. Strict Environment, Exam timings.
NIT Warangal 4.1 (622 Reviews) 4.1 4.0 Neat and Clean Campus, Scholarships, Friendly and supportive teachers, Admission process, and Top recruiters. Fewer campus placements, Poor maintenance of hostels, and mandatory attendance.

Engineering Colleges in Telangana FAQs

Ques. Which are the top 5 Engineering Colleges in Hyderabad?

Ans. IIT Hyderabad, NIT Warangal, IIIT Hyderabad, BITS Hyderabad, and JNTUH Hyderabad are the top 5 Engineering Colleges in Hyderabad.

Ques. What are the eligibility criteria for enrolling in the top engineering Colleges in Telangana?

Ans. Students should score between 45% and 75% in Class 12 (marks vary depending on the college), followed by marks in entrance exams, i.e, JEE Main or EAM-CET, to be eligible for top BTech colleges in Hyderabad.

Ques. Which Engineering College in Telangana has the lowest fees for BTech?

Ans. MANUU Hyderabad is the name of the college that charges a total fee of INR 42 K for the Engineering Certification program.

Ques. What are the top 5 colleges for ME/M.Tech in Telangana?

Ans. The top 5 colleges in Telangana for ME/M. Tech are IIT Hyderabad, NIT Warangal, IIIT Hyderabad, BITS Hyderabad, and JNTUH Hyderabad.

Ques. Which are the most Popular entrance exams accepted by top BTech colleges?

Ans. JEE Main, EAMCET, and JEE Advanced are the main entrance exams considered by most colleges during the BTech admission process. Here is the list of all entrance exams accepted by colleges in Telangana.
